concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-br-transactions-settlement-funding-timeline]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted BR/Brazil-route Braintree Direct settlement-and-funding snapshot covering the fixed account cutoff, successful-settlement prerequisite, linked-PayPal-account and bank sequence, credit installments, debit timing and exclusion, sent-versus-arrived meaning and refund adjustments; no currency is specified, and it is not current bank/processor policy, a sibling-account schedule, a timing guarantee, or proof of settlement, disbursement or arrival
warnings: The page names no currency or card brands; do not infer BRL, conversion behavior or brand-specific timing.
Keep the 10:45pm CT cutoff, linked PayPal account path, installment cadence, debit handling, refund effects and timing scoped to this captured BR route and applicable account.
The debit-card two-day expectation has no stated starting event; do not re-anchor it to authorization, submission, settlement or disbursement.
Settlement confirmation, PayPal-account disbursement, bank sweep, Disbursement Date and bank visibility are distinct events, and qualified timing is not proof or a guarantee.
